multi_store.nav_description: Open another store, like a restaurant beside your shop, with its own products, orders and settings
multi_store.title: Store list
multi_store.subtitle: Each store keeps its own catalog, orders, payment methods and settings. Switch between them from the store menu at the top of the sidebar.
multi_store.sheet_description: The new store starts with its own sales channel, market, warehouse and taxes. You become its admin.

help.country: Sets the store's currency, language, delivery zones and warehouse.
help.copied_from_current: Leave blank to use the current store's.

vietqr.nav_description: Bank accounts that receive VietQR transfers, and the bank notifications they sent.
vietqr.title: VietQR bank transfers
vietqr.subtitle: Customers scan a QR at checkout or at the counter; the bank's notification confirms the payment.

no_method.title: No VietQR payment method yet
no_method.description: Add a payment method of type VietQR under Settings → Payment methods, then come back to add the bank accounts it receives money on.

provider_help.sepay: SePay sends a webhook for every incoming transfer. Paste the webhook URL below into SePay and use the same secret.
provider_help.payos: PayOS creates a payment link per order and calls the webhook when it is paid.
provider_help.manual: No bank notification: staff confirm each transfer by hand.

help.account_name: As printed by the bank, without accents.
help.keyword_init: Starts the transfer content, e.g. PV + order number. Leave blank to use the payment method's prefix.
help.sub_account: Only when SePay routes this account through a sub-account.
help.priority: Lower numbers are chosen first (single and quota waterfall strategies).
help.routing_weight: Stored for weighted routing; no strategy uses it yet.
help.monthly_quota: Stop routing here once this much was allocated this month. Blank for no limit.
help.monthly_threshold: The quota waterfall strategy prefers other accounts above this amount. Blank for none.

accounts.help: Payments are routed across the active accounts by the payment method's routing strategy.
accounts.empty: No receiving account yet — VietQR is hidden at checkout and at the POS until you add one.
accounts.sheet_description: The QR shown to customers pays into this account.

delete_confirm.title: Remove this account?
delete_confirm.message: {{account}} will no longer receive VietQR payments. An account that already received payments is deactivated instead, so past payments keep their record.

events.resolve_help: Match it to the order the customer paid for, or process it again after fixing the account setup.

guide.intro: VietQR shows a bank-transfer QR with the exact amount and transfer content; the bank's notification confirms the payment.
guide.after_create: After saving, add the bank accounts it receives money on under Settings → VietQR.
guide.no_account: No active receiving account — customers cannot pay with VietQR yet.
